name: motion-kit
description: Describe a video in plain English, Hindi or Hinglish and get a finished motion graphic (MP4 + cover image): storyboard, matching colours, voice-synced timing and sound, rendered from tested scene templates. Bundles the motion-kit engine, the motion-director skill (text to rendered video) the motion-creative-director skill (concepts, storyboards and per-shot prompts for AI video tools), and the motion-ai-studio skill (each video made with Claude Code only, or with AI-generated plates from Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling and others over MCP).
